answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own knoll record, and its own share of the quartz quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The thread ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 706 identities would post 2926 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
